title: Cambridge IELTS 16 Test 3 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
scenario: Many manufactured food and drink products contain high levels of sugar, which causes many health problems. Sugary products should be made more expensive to encourage people to consume less sugar.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
